user.title: SmartThings Find
user.description:
A Samsung Account QR code will be shown. Scan it with a phone that is signed in to your Samsung account (or open the link on it) and approve the sign-in.

Press **Submit** to generate the code.

reauth_confirm.title: Session expired
reauth_confirm.description: The SmartThings Find session is no longer valid. Press **Submit** to sign in again with a QR code.

login_failed.title: Sign-in not completed
login_failed.description: Press **Submit** to generate a new QR code.

progress.scan_qr:
Scan this code with your phone and approve the Samsung Account sign-in (expires in 3 minutes):

![QR code]({qr_image})

If you are on that phone, open this link: [{qr_url}]({qr_url})

error.timeout: The QR code expired before it was scanned.
error.login_failed: Samsung rejected or did not complete the sign-in. Check the logs for details.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Samsung Account.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in with a different Samsung account than the configured one.

data.active_mode_others: Active mode for other devices (phones, watches, earbuds…)

data_description.update_interval: How often (seconds) SmartThings Find is polled.
data_description.active_mode_tags: Ask the network for a fresh location on every poll instead of only reading the last known one.
data_description.active_mode_others: Same, for phones/tablets/watches. Uses battery and may wake the screen.
